        org     40000

        ld      bc,1000
MLOOP   push    bc
AGAIN   call    RANDOM
        ld      a,h
        and     #1F
        ld      b,a
        ld      a,l
        and     #1F
        ld      l,a
        ld      h,#58
        ld      de,32
        ld      a,b
        cp      24
        jr      nc,AGAIN
        and     a
        jr      z,ZERO
LOOP    add     hl,de
        djnz    LOOP
ZERO    ld      (hl),#FF
        pop     bc
        dec     bc
        ld      a,b
        or      c
        jr      nz,MLOOP
        ret

RANDOM  push    bc
        push    de
        ld      hl,(SEED)
        inc     hl
        ld      d,0
        ld      a,h
        or      l
        jr      nz,NOCARRY
        inc     d
NOCARRY push    de
        push    hl
        sla     l
        rl      h
        rl      d
        add     hl,bc
        adc     a,d
        ld      d,a
        pop     bc
        pop     af
        add     hl,bc
        adc     a,d
        ld      c,a
        ld      b,0
        or      a
        sbc     hl,bc
        adc     hl,bc
        or      a
        sbc     hl,bc
        dec     hl
        ld      (SEED),hl
        pop     de
        pop     bc
        ret
SEED    defw    0
